{{Quote|There's a vault, not far from here. It's a merc operation, holds valuables for anybody with the credits to pay. Our mutual friend is about to pay them a visit.|Jonas Balkar|<ref name="TOR" />}}
'''Axxon Storage and Reclamation''' was a storage vault located in the [[Nikto Sector]] on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] that served as a storage facility for anyone willing to pay. During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], the prototype war droid [[M1-4X]] attacked the vault under the orders of a number of [[Republic Special Forces Division|SpecForce]] traitors led by [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Andrik]].<ref name="TOR" />
